snippet.title: The Coin Chronicle
snippet.description:
The The Coin Chronicle uncovers the decisions, the documents, and the people behind the moments that reshaped money — from the Roman Empire to the Nixon Shock, from the Weimar hyperinflation to the quiet collapse of currencies most people never saw coming.
We answer the questions most financial channels don't ask: How many hours of human labour has one ounce of gold always been worth? Which assets actually survived when empires collapsed — and which ones went to zero? Who made the decisions that changed the value of your money, and what were they thinking when they made them?
This channel is for people who understand that the past is not dead. It is the pattern underneath everything happening right now.
New videos every week. Subscribe, and history will make the present make sense.
📌 Topics: monetary history · gold & silver · economic collapse · hyperinflation · Bretton Woods · the gold standard · financial crises · purchasing power · reserve currencies · hard assets

snippet.title: Why Money?
snippet.description:
Why is gold worth more than iron? Why does a piece of paper — or a line of code — buy you dinner?

Why Money? answers one big question at a time, from first principles. We take the things everyone uses but almost nobody questions — gold, the dollar, Bitcoin, banks, debt, inflation — and trace them back to the real reason they hold value. No hype, no hot takes, no "buy this now." Just calm, carefully researched explainers, original animation, and a story you'll actually remember.

If you've ever wondered what makes anything worth anything at all, you're in the right place.

▶ New explainer regularly. Subscribe and start with "Why Gold?"

snippet.title: A long, long time ago...
snippet.description:
I make videos to help you with your history GCSE, whilst secretly aiming to turn you into a history nerd and increase your historical literacy whilst you're here. (Mwahahaha!)

I mostly cover the topics of Anglo-Saxon & Norman England, Crime & Punishment Through Time, Weimar & Nazi Germany, the Cold War and the American West for the 9-1 Edexcel GCSE spec (though non-GCSE students are welcome here too!). I also sometimes branch out beyond the curriculum into other history topics as part of my secret historical literacy mission!

About me: My name is Jasmine and I use she/her pronouns. I have first class BA in history from the University of Sheffield and am currently studying in Germany for an MA in Public History (contrary to popular belief I'm not a teacher!).

This channel is kept classroom friendly and video comments are heavily moderated.

Timeline of War is a complete, animated chronological breakdown of World War II — from the political chaos that sparked it, to the battles that shaped it, to the aftermath that changed the world forever.

We go week by week through the war, and month by month in long-form episodes, combining claymation-style visuals, unbiased narration, and documentary-grade storytelling.

If you want to understand WWII exactly as it unfolded — every front, every decision, every turning point — you’re in the right place.
Subscribe and follow the war as it actually happened.

snippet.title: Hyperinflation Archiv
snippet.description:
Hyperinflation Archiv - Die Geschichte der Währungskrisen
Hyperinflation Archiv – wo die vergessenen Lehren der Währungskrisen bewahrt werden. Von der Weimarer Hyperinflation 1923 bis heute: präzise historische Analyse, archivierte Warnungen, moderne Relevanz.
Unsere Themen:
📜 Weimarer Hyperinflation 1923 - Eine Billion Mark für ein Brot
🏛️ Bundesbank vs. EZB: Stabilitätskultur vs. Krisenmanagement
💰 Goldreserven, Währungsreformen, monetäre Zusammenbrüche
📊 Deutsche Wirtschaftsgeschichte vom Wirtschaftswunder bis heute
Unsere Mission:
In Zeiten negativer Zinsen und massiver Staatsschulden bewahren wir das historische Gedächtnis. Die Hyperinflation von 1923 ist keine abstrakte Geschichte – sie ist eine Mahnung.
Keine Verschwörungstheorien. Nur präzise historische Analyse mit archivalischer Autorität.
Die Geschichte wiederholt sich nicht – aber sie reimt sich.
Abonnieren Sie, um die Lehren der Geschichte zu bewahren.

snippet.description:
Welcome to Independent Financial Historian - where independent historical research meets financial analysis.

I explore the stories, patterns, and connections that traditional institutions often overlook. As an independent scholar working outside mainstream academic frameworks, I bring you deep dives into history, economics, and geopolitics that challenge conventional narratives.

Historical events that shaped our financial systems
Geopolitical analysis through a historical lens
Alternative perspectives on economics and power
Educational content delivered in a relaxed, accessible style

No formal credentials, no institutional agenda – just rigorous research and honest inquiry.

Subscribe if you're curious about the history they don't teach in classrooms.

Disclaimer: This channel provides educational and historical content only. Nothing here constitutes financial or investment advice. Always conduct your own research before making any investment decisions.

snippet.title: FinanzStratege
snippet.description:
Willkommen auf meinem Kanal!
Hier erkläre ich Wirtschaft, Finanzmärkte, Inflation, Rezession 2026/2027 und warum viele Warnsignale heute wichtiger denn je sind.
Ich zeige dir einfach verständlich, wie Aktienmarkt-Crashs, Geldentwertung, Schuldenkrisen, Goldpreise und Zinsentscheidungen wirklich funktionieren – und was Banken dir nicht erzählen.
Wenn du die Wirtschaft verstehen, dein Geld besser schützen und wichtige Finanztrends früh erkennen willst, dann bist du hier richtig.
Abonniere den Kanal und bleib vorbereitet – die nächste große Veränderung kommt schneller, als viele denken.

snippet.title: Monetary Logs
snippet.description:
''Monetary Logs” is a financial archive that traces the story of money through time. From ancient economies to modern markets, from major financial crashes and economic bubbles to the rise of monetary systems, it explores how value has been created, lost, and transformed throughout history.

This channel goes beyond storytelling — it examines how money evolved, how it shaped power structures, and how it influenced the course of human civilization. From golden ages and hyperinflation events to Wall Street turbulence and the crypto revolution, every chapter finds a place in the Monetary Logs.

The goal is simple: to understand the past, decode the present, and gain clearer insight into the future of global finance.

snippet.title: The History Teacher
snippet.description: Welcome to the History Teacher channel and thanks for dropping in. I am an history teacher with 10 years experience, I wanted to create interactive revision resources that my students would engage with and actually do! I found that one of the biggest problems I had with my GCSE classes was that the students who were going to do well had good revision practice already in place, but my 3/4 borderline kids had no idea where to start and very infrequently did any revision. I started out making these videos for my own students which is why the first few videos are out of sequence. I was just aiming to fill the gaps or explain concepts for their homework tasks. I was absolutely overwhelmed when thousands of students from all over the country started watching. So The History Teacher was born…

snippet.title: Stick Around
snippet.description:
Stick Around is where history stops being a textbook and starts being a story you can't look away from.

Every video takes one true event — a war started over a football match, a team that defied the Nazis, the things ancient humans actually did all day — and turns it into a fast, funny, beautifully animated deep-dive you'll actually remember. Real research, original scripts, hand-drawn-style stick-figure animation, and a hook that doesn't let go.

No fluff, no filler, no clickbait we don't pay off. Just the most fascinating things that ever actually happened.

🎬 New story every week. Subscribe and stick around.

snippet.title: Smart Silver Stacker
snippet.description:
Subscribe to my channel to see videos about stacking silver & gold, geopolitics and macroeconomics, and financial preparedness.

In a world of fiat currency, massive debt, and ever increasing fragility, where can you find a safe haven?  I believe physical precious metals like gold and silver will provide security as we transition from the current financial paradigm to the next.  Metals have served as stores of value for thousands of years, and that is unlikely to change in our lifetime.

None of this channel's content is financial advice, I am merely sharing my thoughts for education and entertainment. I hope my videos provide value to you, and if you've been watching, come join the community and say hello in the comments!
